FDA Cracks Down on Mumbai Eateries Over Health Concerns

The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has taken action against six eateries in Mumbai for violating health standards, including the presence of rats, cockroaches, and expired food. This move aims to improve food safety in the city's restaurants. The FDA's actions are part of a broader effort to ensure that eateries meet minimum hygiene and safety requirements.
